topic: Height and Range of a Projectile
key_concepts: Projectile motion combines constant horizontal velocity with constant vertical acceleratio
Horizontal acceleration is zero and vertical acceleration is -g
Initial velocity components are v0x = v0 cos θ and v0y = v0 sin θ
At maximum height, the vertical component of velocity is zero
Time to reach maximum height is t = v0 sin θ / g
Maximum height is H = v0^2 sin^2 θ / (2g)
Total time of flight is twice the time to reach maximum height
Maximum range is R = v0^2 sin 2θ / g
Height and range depend on initial velocity and launch angle
A 45° launch angle gives maximum range
A 90° launch angle gives zero range and a 0° angle gives zero height
